summary.en: A multimodal family spanning text, speech, and long-form content.
summary.zh: 覆盖文本、语音与长文本内容的多模态模型系列。

title.en: MiniMax matters when the workflow crosses media types.
title.zh: 当工作流跨越多种媒体类型时，MiniMax 才有独特价值。

description.en: The platform matrix positions MiniMax across text, speech, and long-form multimodal work. No exact model ID was supplied, so this page describes capability scope rather than inventing a release name.
description.zh: 平台矩阵将 MiniMax 定位于文本、语音与长文本多模态任务。由于现有资料未提供准确 Model ID，本页说明能力范围，不虚构发布名称。

prompts.en: Turn this script into spoken content
Work across this long mixed-media brief
prompts.zh: 处理这份长篇混合媒体简报

title.en: Text, speech, and long-form work in one family.
title.zh: 一个系列覆盖文本、语音与长内容。

description.en: This is an ecosystem capability listing, not a promise that one unnamed model handles every modality.
description.zh: 这是生态能力范围说明，不代表某个未命名模型包办所有模态。

description.en: Drafting, transformation, and general language work.
description.zh: 起草、转换与通用语言任务。
面向语音创作与处理的能力路径。

description.en: Work that combines long content with more than one modality.
description.zh: 结合长内容与多种模态的任务。

question.en: Which MiniMax model ID is supported?
question.zh: 支持哪个 MiniMax Model ID？

answer.en: The supplied matrix names capability categories rather than a specific ID, so this page does not claim one.
answer.zh: 现有矩阵给出的是能力类别，而非具体 ID，因此本页不声称某个型号。

question.en: Is MiniMax in the current client picker?
question.zh: MiniMax 在当前客户端选择器中吗？

answer.en: It is listed in platform and ecosystem support, not in the supplied current picker list.
answer.zh: 它属于平台与生态支持，不在现有客户端选择器清单中。

title.en: Track MiniMax when the workflow becomes multimodal.
title.zh: 当工作流走向多模态时，关注 MiniMax。

description.en: Judge the eventual product route by its exact model, modality, and availability—not by the family name alone.
description.zh: 应根据最终产品界面的具体模型、模态与可用性判断，而不能只看系列名称。
